hook.en: For centuries mushrooms and bacteria were called plants. Today we know a mushroom is closer to us than to a mango tree. How did our classification change?
hook.kn: ಶತಮಾನಗಳ ಕಾಲ ಅಣಬೆ ಮತ್ತು ಬ್ಯಾಕ್ಟೀರಿಯಾಗಳನ್ನು ಸಸ್ಯಗಳೆಂದು ಕರೆಯಲಾಗುತ್ತಿತ್ತು. ನಮ್ಮ ವರ್ಗೀಕರಣ ಹೇಗೆ ಬದಲಾಯಿತು?

objectives.en: Trace classification from Aristotle to Whittaker
State the criteria of the five-kingdom system
Recall the basic features of Plantae and Animalia

narration.en: For centuries mushrooms and bacteria were called plants. Today we know a mushroom is closer to us than to a mango tree. How did our classification change?
narration.kn: ಶತಮಾನಗಳ ಕಾಲ ಅಣಬೆ ಮತ್ತು ಬ್ಯಾಕ್ಟೀರಿಯಾಗಳನ್ನು ಸಸ್ಯಗಳೆಂದು ಕರೆಯಲಾಗುತ್ತಿತ್ತು. ನಮ್ಮ ವರ್ಗೀಕರಣ ಹೇಗೆ ಬದಲಾಯಿತು?

body.en: Aristotle classified plants into trees, shrubs and herbs, and animals into those with red blood and those without. Linnaeus used two kingdoms, Plantae and Animalia. The two-kingdom system lumped together prokaryotes and eukaryotes, unicellular and multicellular forms, and photosynthetic and non-photosynthetic fungi, so it was not satisfactory.
body.kn: ಅರಿಸ್ಟಾಟಲ್ ಸಸ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಮರ, ಪೊದೆ, ಮೂಲಿಕೆ ಎಂದೂ ಪ್ರಾಣಿಗಳನ್ನು ಕೆಂಪು ರಕ್ತ ಇರುವ ಮತ್ತು ಇಲ್ಲದವು ಎಂದೂ ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಿದರು. ಲಿನ್ನಿಯಸ್ ಎರಡು ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯ ಪದ್ಧತಿ ನೀಡಿದರು; ಅದು ಸಮರ್ಪಕವಾಗಿರಲಿಲ್ಲ.

title.en: On the board: From two kingdoms to five

say.en: Linnaeus put all living things into just two kingdoms.
But it lumped together very different organisms.
Monera are prokaryotes; the other four kingdoms are eukaryotes.
His five criteria were cell structure, body organisation, nutrition, reproduction and phylogeny.

body.en: R.H. Whittaker in 1969 proposed five kingdoms: Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae and Animalia. His criteria were cell structure, body organisation, mode of nutrition, reproduction and phylogenetic relationships. Plantae are eukaryotic, chlorophyll-containing and have cellulose cell walls; Animalia are heterotrophic, multicellular eukaryotes without cell walls.
body.kn: 1969 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಆರ್.ಎಚ್. ವಿಟ್ಟೇಕರ್ ಐದು ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸಿದರು: ಮೊನೆರಾ, ಪ್ರೊಟಿಸ್ಟಾ, ಶಿಲೀಂಧ್ರ, ಸಸ್ಯ, ಪ್ರಾಣಿ. ಆಧಾರ: ಕೋಶ ರಚನೆ, ದೇಹ ಸಂಘಟನೆ, ಪೋಷಣೆ ವಿಧಾನ, ಸಂತಾನೋತ್ಪತ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ವಂಶಾವಳಿ ಸಂಬಂಧ.

problem.en: Using Whittaker's criteria, decide the kingdom of (a) a yeast cell and (b) a bacterium.

steps.en: Yeast: eukaryotic cell, heterotrophic (absorptive), cell wall of chitin → kingdom Fungi.
Bacterium: prokaryotic cell with no nuclear membrane → kingdom Monera.
Cell structure alone already separates them: prokaryote versus eukaryote.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. Using Whittaker's criteria, decide the kingdom of (a) a yeast cell and (b) a bacterium.

heading.en: Five kingdoms in order of complexity

body.en: Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae, Animalia: from prokaryotes to complex multicellular eukaryotes.
